description: Whether a company's share price sits above or below what its owner earnings support, from its SEC filings: value per share on three anchors, the price's gap to each, a margin-of-safety ladder, and the growth the price requires. Same engine as owner_earnings_valuation. Returns refused, with the reason, when the business has no durable owner earnings to value. Example questions: "Is Coca-Cola undervalued at $70?"; "What's Deere's intrinsic value?"; "Is MSFT overvalued right now?"

long_bond_pct.description: Long-bond yield in percent (5.4 = 5.4%). Default: the latest 30-year Treasury par yield, fetched from treasury.gov

ticker.description: US-listed ticker that files with the SEC, e.g. KO or BRK.B

name: is_this_stock_undervalued
title: Is This Stock Undervalued?
